# PetCalc Tools

> Free dog and cat calculators with cited formulas: puppy weight, dog and cat food calories, age conversion, body condition, due dates, chocolate toxicity, and water intake. Educational only, not veterinary advice.

## Calculators
- [Puppy Weight Calculator](https://www.petcalctools.example/tools/puppy-weight-calculator/): predict adult weight from age and current weight
- [Dog Food Calculator](https://www.petcalctools.example/tools/dog-food-calculator/): daily kcal and cups from RER and MER
- [Puppy Food Calculator](https://www.petcalctools.example/tools/puppy-food-calculator/): growth-stage feeding amounts
- [Homemade & Raw Dog Food Calculator](https://www.petcalctools.example/tools/homemade-dog-food-calculator/): portion ranges as a percent of body weight
- [Dog Age Calculator](https://www.petcalctools.example/tools/dog-age-calculator/): dog years to human years by size
- [Cat Age Calculator](https://www.petcalctools.example/tools/cat-age-calculator/): cat years to human years and life stage
- [Cat Food Calculator](https://www.petcalctools.example/tools/cat-food-calculator/): daily kcal and cups for cats
- [Dog BMI & Body Condition Helper](https://www.petcalctools.example/tools/dog-bmi-calculator/): body condition screening
- [Dog Pregnancy Calculator](https://www.petcalctools.example/tools/dog-pregnancy-calculator/): whelping due date
- [Dog Chocolate Toxicity Calculator](https://www.petcalctools.example/tools/dog-chocolate-toxicity-calculator/): theobromine dose estimate
- [Dog Water Intake Calculator](https://www.petcalctools.example/tools/dog-water-intake-calculator/): daily water range
